scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm --workspace @connect4/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm --workspace @connect4/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @connect4/web run test && cargo test --manifest-path crates/solver/Cargo.toml
scripts.format: npm --workspace @connect4/web run format && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/solver/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: npm --workspace @connect4/web run format:check && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/solver/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @connect4/web run lint && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/solver/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
